newsitem.title: USA: Goodrich Petroleum sets acquisition vote.
newsitem.headline: Goodrich Petroleum sets acquisition vote.

text.p: Goodrich Petroleum Corp said Monday it has scheduled a special meeting on December 19 for stockholders to vote on the proposed issuance of 750,000 shares of Series B convertible preferred stock of its subsidiary, Goodrich Acquisition II Inc.
The stock is to be issued as a portion of the consideration in its recently announced acquisition of the oil and natural gas properties of La/Cal Energy Partners II.
Shareholders of record as November 18 are eligible to vote at the meeting.

The interests to be acquired are located in seven separate fields in South Louisiana and East Texas and include proved reserves of some 1,718,000 barrels of oil and 3.91 billion cubic feet of natural gas, the company said in late October when the deal was announced.

The purchase price of about $17.45 million includes $2 million in cash, $7.5 million in shares of the newly designated series of convertible preferred stock and the assumption of $7.95 million in debt.
Goodrich Petroleum is an oil and gas exploration company.
